programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Elegy
programmes.d: Three astronauts land on what looks like Earth 200 years before they left--only all of the people seem frozen in time.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mirror Image
programmes.d: Millicent Barnes sees her double at a bus terminal.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Monsters are Due on Maple Street
programmes.d: Paranoia strikes the residents of Maple Street when they believe human-looking aliens have invaded the neighborhood.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A World of Difference
programmes.d: Businessman Arthur Curtis discovers that life as he knows it doesn't really exist.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Long Live Walter Jameson
programmes.d: Walter Jameson is an excellent history teacher who talks about the past as if he had lived it.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: People Are Alike All Over
programmes.d: When a space exploration crashes on Mars, the surviving passenger is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking, very friendly and apparently just like us...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Execution
programmes.d: Just before being hanged for shooting a man in the back, a man in 1880 is transported into the year 1959 by a professor who soon realizes that he has brought forward a savage killer.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish
programmes.d: An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A Nice Place to Visit
programmes.d: After being shot to death, Rocky Valentine encounters the amiable white-haired Mr. Pip, who gives Rocky everything he wishes for.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare as a Child
programmes.d: Schoolteacher Helen Foley finds a strange and very serious little girl on the stairs outside her apartment. The little girl seems to know her and tries to jog her memory about a man she saw earlier that day. The man arrives at Helen's door…

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A Stop at Willoughby
programmes.d: Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.

programmes.t: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programmes.d: Steven er dygtig hjertekirurg og gift med Anna, der er respekteret øjenlæge. De lever lykkeligt med deres to børn. Steven er ven med den 16-årige Martin, som er forældreløs. Tingene tager en mørk drejning, da Steven introducerer Martin for familien.

programmes.t: Creepshow
programmes.d: En hyldest til 50'ernes horrortegneserier med fem historier af Stephen King. Horrormester King spiller med i en af historierne.

programmes.t: Byzantium
programmes.d: To mystiske kvinder lever som vampyrer i skyggerne. Da deres fortid indhenter dem, udfolder sig en episk kamp mellem overlevelse og det fortryllende mysterium ved evigt liv.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Curious Case of Edgar Witherspoon
programmes.d: A woman tries to get her Uncle Edgar committed, believing that he is senile. The investigating doctor finds Edgar living in an apartment containing all kinds of junk.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Extra Innings
programmes.d: Ex-baseball player Ed Hamler, lame from an injury and forced to retire early is given a 1909 baseball card of a player that looks exactly like him. The card is magical in that he becomes drawn into it and lives out the life of the player in the past.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Crossing
programmes.d: A stressed-out priest repeatedly encounters a station wagon containing a young girl. The car keeps crashing and bursting into flames.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Card
programmes.d: A compulsive spender accepts "The Card" to keep up her habit. Unfortunately stringent penalties kick in for late payments.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Hocus-Pocus and Frisby
programmes.d: A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Trade-Ins
programmes.d: An elderly couple visit the New Life Corporation, hoping to transport their personalities into youthful artificial bodies.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Gift
programmes.d: An alien who crash-lands into a remote mountain village stirs up the villagers' fears and animosity, but he befriends a little boy and gives him a mysterious present.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Dummy
programmes.d: A ventriloquist is convinced that his dummy, Willie, is alive and evil. He makes plans for a new act with a new dummy: plans that Willie doesn't support!

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Young Man's Fancy
programmes.d: When a newlywed couple briefly returns to the groom's childhood home, the ties of the past prove too strong to resist.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric
programmes.d: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Cavender is Coming
programmes.d: Cavender, an angel trying to win his wings, tries to help down-on-her-luck Agnes, who has just been fired.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Steel
programmes.d: Boxing robot "Battling Maxo" breaks down before the scheduled bout, forcing his manager to take its place.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare at 20,000 Feet
programmes.d: Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Last Night of a Jockey
programmes.d: A dejected jockey wants to be tall.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Living Doll
programmes.d: Erich is displeased when his wife buys an expensive doll for his step-daughter. He becomes even more displeased when the doll tells him it doesn't like him!

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Old Man in the Cave
programmes.d: A mysterious guardian helps a tiny community survive after the Bomb destroys much of the Earth.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Uncle Simon
programmes.d: Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Probe 7, Over and Out
programmes.d: The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
programmes.d: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A Short Drink from a Certain Fountain
programmes.d: Trying to keep up with his younger wife, Harmon convinces his brother to inject him with an experimental youth serum.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Ninety Years Without Slumbering
programmes.d: An old man fears that he will die if his grandfather clock stops running.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
programmes.d: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: You Drive
programmes.d: Driving home one rainy evening, Oliver Pope accidentally hits a boy on a bicycle. Pope flees the scene, determined to hide his guilt, but his car has other ideas.
